name: Sketch to Editorial Render
description: Upload a 2D eyewear sketch → Gemini analyzes it → Prompt compiled → Nano Banana generates editorial render
author: AGENT 1

data.inputPrompt: Analyze this 2D eyewear sketch. Extract: brand DNA cues, structural architecture (frame type, bridge, temples, hinge, lens shape), materials, and manufacturing feasibility. Return a structured JSON with fields: brand_dna, eyewear_structure, manufacturing_notes, prompt_seed.

data.prompt:
A high-end editorial studio photograph of a visionary next-generation optical system, presented as a hyper-realistic 3D photographic render.

CONCEPT & EYEWEAR ARCHITECTURE
[Gemini analysis output will guide this section]

STRUCTURAL ENGINEERING & MANUFACTURABILITY
Real hinge positioning with precise integration. Plausible lens anchoring with controlled bevel transitions.

MATERIALS & MICRO-ENGINEERING PRECISION
Microscopic surface grain, precise hinge articulation, subtle micro fasteners. Accurate bevel transitions.

OPTICAL GEOMETRY & LIGHT INTERACTION
Accurate highlight roll-off. Subtle internal reflections. Coherent coating behavior.

PHOTOGRAPHY & STUDIO LIGHTING
Medium format aesthetic, 100mm macro equivalent. Large diffused softbox, subtle rim accent.

SPATIAL CONTEXT
Seamless luxury studio cyclorama. Pearl white background.

GRAPHIC LAYOUT & EDITORIAL UI
Bottom right: small monochrome brand logo. Bottom left: OPTICAL PROTOTYPE technical description.
